# Design point P006

## Description

An external routing database directs each repository request to a machine hosting a replica, while clients traverse commits, trees, and parents through sequentially dependent Git object lookups. The placement mechanism provides replica selection, but the workload approach may retain latency and metadata costs because traversal remains dependent on successive lookups.
